about_the_game:
After years of battling alcoholism and depression, a father finally finds the strength to seek the truth about his son. On a beautiful spring day in 1986, he sent his boy off to school — but the child never returned. No one knows what happened. The school administration remained silent, whether out of fear or denial.

Overwhelmed by grief, the father tried to bury the horrors deep inside, drowning his pain in alcohol. His wife couldn’t bear the burden and left him. Now, years later, he returns to the abandoned Soviet-era school to confront the dark secrets lurking within its shadows.

In this first-person horror game, you step into the shoes of a broken man who is finally searching for the truth about his son. Explore haunting, empty corridors, gather disturbing clues, and face a chilling truth that no one ever dared to speak of. As the line between reality and nightmare fades, uncover a mystery long buried in silence.

Game Features:

  • Realistic graphics.

  • An interesting and emotional story highlighted through found letters and various clues.

  • The main genre of the game is a walking simulator and survival.

  • Jumpscares and terrifying moments.

  • Powered by Unreal Engine 5.6.

DEVELOPER ANNOUNCEMENT

I’m truly grateful to everyone who played my previous game, No Forgiveness. It means a lot to me to be able to create experiences that bring tension and excitement to players.

This is my second game, and everyone who plays and supports it gives me the motivation and opportunity to move forward — toward a third one.

Thank you once again.
See you soon! :)

name: The Erased Student Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570K or AMD FX-8310
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: First-person horror game set in an abandoned Soviet-era school. You play as a Russian father whose son vanished years ago. Explore the decaying building, read forgotten letters, follow clues, and uncover a dark and disturbing truth.
